title: Co-Branded Card Headstart toward Summit Tier Status
content:
Holders of the Crestline co-branded card receive a headstart in the counted qualifying dollars on which the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program sets the tier of the calendar year. The card is shown by the companion certificate issued on a card anniversary, as its record under the Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes charter shows it.

**Terms.**

- A Crestline Companion Certificate First or Premium Economy issued on a card anniversary within the last 12 months adds 1500 USD to the counted qualifying dollars.
- A Crestline Companion Certificate Main Cabin or Main Plus issued on a card anniversary within the last 12 months adds 750 USD.
- A member with no such certificate issued in that span adds no card headstart.

**Within the last 12 months** means that fewer than 12 whole calendar months have passed from the certificate's issue date to the day the tier is set. Hypothetical boundary: a certificate issued on 5 August 2025 is inside the span on 4 August 2026 and outside it on 5 August 2026.

**Hypothetical cases.**

| Card-anniversary certificate | Issued | Headstart (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Companion Certificate First | 3 months ago | 1500 |
| Crestline Companion Certificate Main Plus | 11 months ago | 750 |
| Crestline Companion Certificate Premium Economy | 14 months ago | None |
| No card-anniversary certificate | | None |
